game.title: Cleveland Browns at New York Jets

lede: New York Jets carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#28 in EPA per play), while Cleveland Browns owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#7 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it New York Jets +2.2 with a fair total of 39.8 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is New York Jets pass offence vs Cleveland Browns pass defence, which sits −0.262 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Cleveland Browns and New York Jets have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
